species.name: Yellow perch
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.
Best water today is 4–30 ft deep, mostly on channel edges.
The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.

species.name: Northern pike
why: Water 43°F on top, much colder than they like, so they move slowly and stay deep.

The lake is mixed top to bottom, so fish can use many depths.
Southeast wind at 24 mph pushes bait onto the northwest shore: try the wind-blown banks.
